name: Dr. Mathews Kurian
text: Ordered an 8-seater solid teak dining table with customized fluted legs. The finish and natural timber grain are exceptional, delivered and assembled on time right to our dining room.

name: Fathima & Niyas
text: We got our sitout charukasera pair and king-size storage cot crafted here. Direct workshop pricing with no showroom middlemen markups. Outstanding handcrafted woodwork quality!

name: Antony Joseph
text: The team handled delivery and assembly to our Kakkanad apartment flawlessly. Genuine seasoned teak wood with solid mortise-and-tenon joinery that will last generations.

name: Adv. Priya S. Nair
text: Customized our living room sofa frame and fluted coffee table. Beautiful craftsmanship, very respectful installation team, and backed by a genuine 5-year workshop warranty.

name: Binu George
text: Top-notch craftsmanship. We visited the workshop at MES Junction before placing our order. The transparency in wood selection, polish tones, and honest pricing is unmatched.
